nodes.name: _shared README
nodes.summary: Adapter-layer overview for the .claude/skills/_shared/ directory. Describes the three contents (vcli.sh wrapper, convention.md naming contract, scripts/ helpers), the one-time symlink install (linking vcli.sh as both `vcli` and `virtuoso` on PATH), and editing rules: changes here affect every skill (client-SDK-release grade); keep vcli.sh a thin pass-through; convention.md owns the name mapping.
nodes.languageNotes: Short markdown (38 lines, 30 non-empty) with three H2 sections (One-time install, Editing rules) and a contents table. Pure prose + a single bash install snippet; no executable logic.

nodes.name: vcli ↔ virtuoso naming convention
nodes.summary: Single source of truth for the `vcli` (binary) vs `virtuoso` (documented name) convention used by 16 of 27 SKILL.md files. Covers: TL;DR mapping table, why the corpus uses `virtuoso` (collision with the Cadence GUI executable, documentation drift), how the vcli.sh adapter resolves the binary (VCLI_BIN override → ~/.cargo/bin/vcli → ./target/release/vcli → PATH → /opt/cargo/bin/vcli) and forwards argv unchanged, one-time install recipe, the single-point migration contract (only vcli.sh + convention.md change when the binary is renamed), SKILL.md hygiene rules (use `virtuoso` in examples; allowed-tools globs), an extensive diagnostic playbook with 13 H3-level rules covering disk-cache silent writes, ramic_bridge.il one-shot load, Admin-gated RPC pool split, snake_case RPC naming, Maestro write split, IC25 SKILL string-quoted kwargs, ADE Editing-mode `mae*` session resolution, bypass-mode maestro.run disk-only writes, IC25 compressed PSF, session-close ownership, ?session + ~>name rejection, VB_REMOTE_HOST requirements for create_corner_netlist, and Cadence-version citation hygiene, plus a maintenance contract describing when to edit and when not to.
nodes.languageNotes: Long markdown (532 lines, 414 non-empty) with 26 sections (3 H1, 16 H2, 7 H3). Mixes prose, tables, fenced bash snippets, and bullet lists. No executable code; pure reference document organized as TL;DR + rationale + install + rules + maintenance contract.

nodes.name: vcli.sh wrapper
nodes.summary: Bash adapter that bridges the `virtuoso` documented name to the actual `vcli` Rust binary. Performs five roles: identity (accepts both names via $0 basename, forwards argv unchanged), binary resolution (VCLI_BIN override → ~/.cargo/bin/vcli → ./target/release/vcli → command -v vcli → /opt/cargo/bin/vcli, with PATH-ordering rationale documented inline), stderr logging (duplicates into $VB_LOG_DIR/harness-YYYYMMDD.log so forensic traces survive the harness's stdout buffer TTL), environment defaults (sets VB_TIMEOUT=120 if unset), and doctor subcommand diagnostics. Execs the resolved binary so its exit code reaches the harness unmodified. Does NOT rewrite argv, inject --format json, retry, or swallow errors.
nodes.languageNotes: POSIX bash with `set -euo pipefail`. 120 lines total, ~112 non-empty. Uses only built-ins (printf, basename, date, mkdir, command, cat, exec) plus shell parameter expansion and a heredoc for the doctor output. No external commands beyond the resolved vcli binary. Comment-heavy (~50% of the file is header documentation explaining rationale).
